requirement: v3.5.1 dsh-fix real-machine reverification: on the real Windows machine with @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin@3.5.1 pinned in profile desktop (DSH desktop 0.2.2-rc.5, Node v26), prove that (a) the dsh-fix row is installed and mounted (subpath export importable and apply() wrote its state marker), (b) the offline CLI is read-only safe against the real $DSH_HOME (scan finds the real sessions, renumber validates a real v4 log copy through the installed Harness and writes zero bytes), (c) the synthetic repair drill on a temp DSH_HOME built from three unmodified real v4 logs appends a legal image/offload event for the two really-broken sessions, skips the compaction-shadowed session, refuses without --force while DSH runs, and leaves the two repaired logs runtime-verified, and (d) the installed listener loop retries 1-3 times, gives up after maxRepairsPerTurn=3, delegates real network errors, and converges once the projection marks the image offloaded. The G4 renumber boundary discovered during this run (image/offload data.targets[].seq is not rewritten) is recorded as a safe-refusal finding for the follow-up fix.

assertions.install: profile desktop pins @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin@3.5.1; the seven dsh-fix files are byte-identical (SHA-256) to the repository build; import('@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin/dsh-fix') succeeds and exports apply/findUnreadableImages/inject/name/resolveDshHome/resolveObjectsRoot/resolveStatePath; the shipped cordis.patch.yml row is - id: dsh-fix, config {maxRepairsPerTurn: 3}, default enabled and the profile patch layer does not disable it
assertions.mount: $DSH_HOME/xclient/dsh-fix-state.json exists: {version:1, mountedAt:2026-11-19T03:27:23.283Z, objectsRoot:C:\Users\fangw\.dsh\attachments\v1\objects, maxRepairsPerTurn:3, repairs:0, lastRepair:null}; the plugin-manager fiberPhase/patchId API answers 401 to that shell, so mount is evidenced by the apply()-written marker plus the importable subpath
assertions.host_health: host main process alive, no OOM/crash, RSS about 1.69 GB (host baseline); mounting dsh-fix writes only one <200 B JSON marker
assertions.readonly_cli_real_home: w2m-fix scan --json against the real $DSH_HOME: scanned 44, broken 0, unreadable 0 (twice identical); backups --session e435 returns the session with backups: []; renumber --delete-seq 0 --dry-run on a copy of a real v4 log: 4->3 events, mapping_changes 3, runtime_verified true (validated by the installed Harness, format v4), future_append true [installed-harness], 0 bytes written, no .bak created, original log SHA-256 unchanged
assertions.synthetic_repair_drill: temp DSH_HOME built from three unmodified real v4 logs + empty attachment object store (deleted after): 5faf0ea6 broken pending 1 @ seq 1003, 9603c5c8 broken pending 2 @ 6892/7005 with the shadowed ref correctly excluded, 1ed0e3a7 (12 shadowed missing images) correctly not reported; fix --apply without --force exits 3 'refusing to write: DeepSeek Harness is running.'; fix --apply --force appends one image/offload to each (seq 2796 +112 B; seq 7551 +119 B targets 6892/7005), backups match pre-repair bytes; after repair scan 0 broken, frames/lastSeq +1 exactly, no torn frames, 0 residual pending images, and both repaired logs pass the installed-Harness renumber runtime validation (runtime_verified true, future_append true)
assertions.installed_listener_loop_sim: in-process simulation with the installed lib/dsh-fix.js and a fake session: TRANSPORT turns 1-3 -> retry (append image/offload + flush, marker repairs 3), turn 4 -> next at the maxRepairsPerTurn bound, NETWORK code -> next (real network errors are not masked), offloaded projection -> next (self-converging); this is a simulation, not a live failed agent turn
assertions.g4_renumber_boundary: renumber rewrites only *Seq/*Seqs keys; image/offload data.targets[].seq is not rewritten, so --delete-seq 0 on the repaired log is refused by the installed Harness (RENUMBER_RUNTIME_REJECTED: 'invalid seed event at index 2795: image/offload: image index 0 does not exist', zero write) while --delete-seq 2795 (post-target) passes runtime_verified true; severity low (safe refusal, no silent corruption) and the targets rewrite is the recorded follow-up fix
assertions.real_home_zero_write: three copied real logs unchanged (SHA-256), 0 real sessions .bak-* files, marker repairs still 0, temp home and temp copies deleted; no real $DSH_HOME file was written
assertions.not_verified: no naturally broken session exists in the real home (scan 0 broken), so the live agent/request-error -> retry path was not triggered; npm/GitHub/tag state was not inspected or changed and no publish action was taken
